title: Easper: An Accessible ASR Pipeline for Language Documentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio transcription is a critical bottleneck in language documentation. While multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models like Whisper offer solutions, field linguists often lack the expertise to utilise them. We present Easper, an open-source, no-code workflow enabling linguists to iteratively fine-tune ASR models via cloud resources directly from ELAN annotations. Deploying ASR also raises a cold start problem: deciding which recordings to transcribe first to bootstrap an accurate model. Using Easper, we evaluate transcription prioritisation strategies on three Vanuatu languages (Bislama, Nafsan, Nguna). We fine-tune models by recording session, comparing Character Error Rate trajectories when prioritising acoustic cleanliness versus linguistic richness. translated_title: Easper：面向语言文档的可访问自动语音识别流程
translated_abstract: 音频转录是语言文档工作中的关键瓶颈。尽管像Whisper这样的多语言自动语音识别（ASR）模型提供了解决方案，但田野语言学家往往缺乏利用这些模型的专业知识。我们提出了Easper，一个开源、无需编码的工作流程，使语言学家能够通过云端资源直接从ELAN注释中迭代微调ASR模型。部署ASR还引发了一个冷启动问题：即决定首先转录哪些录音以引导出准确的模型。利用Easper，我们在三种瓦努阿图语言（比斯拉马语、纳夫桑语、恩古纳语）上评估了转录优先级策略。我们按录音会话微调模型，比较了在优先考虑声学清晰度与语言丰富度时的字符错误率轨迹。我们证明，优先处理词汇丰富的叙事并增加声学-语音重复，即使在嘈杂环境中，也能更快地改善转录效果。
tldr: 本文提出Easper，一个无需编码的ASR微调流程，并通过实验证明优先转录词汇丰富的叙事能显著提升转录效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Easper, a no-code ASR fine-tuning workflow, and demonstrates that prioritizing lexically rich narratives significantly improves transcription efficiency.
